color.note: Four themes: two palettes (Paper default, Atlas alternate) × light and dark. Semantic colors (success, warning, danger, info) are shared by both palettes and change only between light and dark. Every text pair is verified at 4.5:1 or better; see README › Contrast.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind everything. Notes sit directly on it, never in a card.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Side nav panel only.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs, dialogs, the search overlay.

tokens.name: surface-active
tokens.usage: Selected nav item, active section in the presentation rail, hover fill on quiet buttons.

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Tag chip fill. Never used for buttons, so tags and actions stay distinguishable.

tokens.name: mat
tokens.usage: The frame around a hero photo in presentation, so photos never float on the ground.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: All primary copy. ≥11.8:1 on bg, sidebar, surface, surface-active and chip in every theme.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, meta lines, captions, counts' units. ≥4.9:1 on every ground in every theme.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline rules between sections and around cards. Decorative separation only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Outline of inputs, the search field and the dashed +Tag chip. ≥3:1 against bg and surface (non-text contrast).

tokens.name: contour
tokens.usage: The faint contour lines in country, region and city headers (D-41). The app's only decoration; nowhere else.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Exactly three jobs: the one primary action on a screen, links, and the selected/hero marker. Also the focus ring. ≥4.6:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent or danger fill. ≥5.8:1.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. Alias of accent in every theme.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Budget Under (difference text), trip Ready. Always paired with a glyph or word. ≥4.9:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Budget Close (difference text). Always paired with a glyph or word. ≥4.7:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Budget Over (difference text), destructive buttons, validation errors. ≥5.0:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: danger-strong
tokens.usage: Budget Way over: fill of the difference pill only, with on-danger-strong text. A filled shape, so it differs from Over by form and lightness, not hue alone. ≥3.2:1 against every ground.

tokens.name: on-danger-strong
tokens.usage: Text on a danger-strong fill. 8.8:1 light, 5.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Trip status Planning. ≥5.0:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: cat-1
tokens.usage: Budget split, largest category. Categories always carry a labeled legend.

tokens.name: cat-2
tokens.usage: Budget split, second category.

tokens.name: cat-3
tokens.usage: Budget split, third category.

tokens.name: cat-4
tokens.usage: Budget split, fourth category.

tokens.name: cat-5
tokens.usage: Budget split, fifth and remaining categories.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per screen: the record's name.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: H2 in notes; screen section titles.

styles.name: subsection
styles.usage: H3 in notes; panel headings (Contents, Photos, Tips).

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Mountain towns, night markets and temple mornings.
styles.usage: The trip idea under the title in presentation only. Max line length 620px.

styles.name: notes
styles.sample: We keep coming back to the north: cooler mornings and a slower pace.
styles.usage: Rich-text body in every notes field. Max line length 720px.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Default UI text: nav, buttons, inputs, lists.

styles.name: ui-strong
styles.usage: Item names in lists and cards; the active nav item.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Type labels under list items; the backup line. Never smaller.

styles.name: num
styles.usage: Counts, durations, day numbers, shortcut keys.

styles.name: money-md
styles.usage: Budget totals in snapshots and the summary ledger.

styles.name: money-lg
styles.usage: The one headline figure on a presentation facts panel.

styles.name: trip-title
styles.usage: Trip name in presentation mode only. Nowhere else in the app.

styles.name: trip-title-sm
styles.usage: Trip name in the full-detail header and comparison columns.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, chip inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; card inner padding (compact).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding; list item gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; section heading to content.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between nav groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked panels in a column.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between major blocks inside a screen.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Screen side padding.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Column gutter between notes and the right column; presentation side padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Photo thumbnails, the Hero badge, budget bars.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chips, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards (trip, POI).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Panels, dialogs, the search overlay, the facts panel.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots only.

shadow.note: Flat by default. One level, only for things that float above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs, the search overlay. Never cards.

duration.note: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, every duration is 0ms.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and press feedback.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Expand/collapse: nav sections, the nav itself, location blocks.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Overlays opening, entering and leaving presentation mode.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Everything that enters or expands.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Things leaving: overlay close, collapse.
